_doc: Step 3 only: empty-belt power at 0, 8, 11.1, 15, 20 rpm (no 25). experiment.py has no plan mode for baseline, so each step is ONE 'baseline' command = one new session (meta has rpm_units output_rpm_cpr11880). 0 rpm = '--kind idle' (belt_run accepts only 0.5..37 rpm); the belt stays braked and its INA260 is still logged. 70 s per step: 10 s settle (not counted) + 60 s counted. 2 rounds, alternating order, round 2 reversed. The operator presses Enter before every step. Created 2026-10-25.
